description: Text search, collations, conversions, and languages catalogue scenarios
comment: Table-driven pack for Text search, collations, conversions, and languages. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply textsearch.config.create with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-FTS-01::textsearch.config.create. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

requiredMigrationPatterns.description: emits native DDL rather than recreating the anchor

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor

scenarios.description: emit a stable diagnostic for textsearch.mapping
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-FTS-01::textsearch.mapping. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable. This atom is an explicit supported/unsupported boundary, not an accidental omission.

requiredDiagnosticPatterns.description: reports a stable capability or scope diagnostic

forbiddenDiagnosticPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor
